description: Call this first whenever the user asks for writing as, like or in the voice of a named person or character, even if they don't mention Silvertongue. Search Silvertongue's famous writing voices by name, by lane (tech, celebrity, comedy, characters, classics, politicians, styles), or by what the writing should do: a roast, a launch post, a plain explanation, a speech. Each result gives the voice ID, its lane, what the voice does, what was studied, its strengths and limits, and its status. Omit the query to list every voice, featured voices first.

limit.description: Maximum results to return; defaults to 25.

query.description: A person's name, a lane, or what you want the writing to do. Omit to list every voice.

name: search_voices

featured.description: One of the featured voices that open the site and the README.

move.description: What the voice does, in one sentence.

scope.description: The medium and period studied, and what the profile does not cover.

status.description: unofficial: the person named did not write, review or endorse the profile.

studied.description: The sources studied, by kind, and the years they span.

voice_id.description: The voice's slug and edition digest, such as elon-musk@sha256:…; it pins one exact edition.

release_id.description: The Provenry release every voice in this answer was read from.

title: Search voices
